title: JobHill
summary: A job board that collects the latest tech internships and new-grad roles for Tec de Monterrey students.
details: JobHill gathers internship and entry-level openings in one place, with filters for location, company and job type. More than 50 students use it to manage their search.
A company view groups every open role at a given employer, and a personal dashboard lets students save postings and track the status of each application.
Scrapers run on GitHub Actions to fetch new offers every 6 hours and re-check old ones every 12. Supabase handles authentication and keeps data in sync across devices.

title: Crosstalk
summary: Get to know someone through the songs they keep playing. Crosstalk reads the lyrics and turns them into a 3D nucleus and a first impression.
details: The idea is simple: the songs someone keeps coming back to say a lot about them, sometimes more than a first conversation. Crosstalk turns that into a first impression you can actually see.
Bring in songs from Spotify, Apple Music or Deezer. Each one is read through its lyrics for mood and meaning, then placed in orbit around a 3D nucleus with its album art.

From there, Crosstalk writes a few lines about the person behind the music and gives the collection a name. You can play the songs, ask the nucleus about them, and share it with a link so someone else can explore it too.

title: Papalote Museum App
summary: An iOS app for Papalote Museo del Niño with a 3D map and an AR scavenger hunt. Chosen as the best of six team projects.
details: Built by a team of five to make museum visits more interactive for kids and families. The museum board picked it as the top project out of six competing teams.
Visitors explore a 3D map of the exhibits and play an AR scavenger hunt built with RealityKit, collecting virtual cards by interacting with real exhibits.
A custom CreateML model recognizes exhibits through the camera to unlock educational content, and Supabase saves each visitor's progress.

title: GlucoPredict
summary: An iOS app that predicts glucose trends so people with diabetes can plan meals and insulin ahead of time.
details: Built for Swift Challenge Fest 2025. Instead of only tracking data, GlucoPredict uses CoreML to forecast blood sugar from meals, exercise and insulin doses.
Live Activities and widgets show updates at a glance, and a Gemini-powered meal planner suggests food that keeps glucose stable.

title: Innovaction Gym Dashboard
summary: An admin dashboard for Innovaction Gym to schedule events and follow member attendance.
details: A team of three built a central hub that replaced the gym's manual scheduling with a calendar interface for admins.
I integrated Chart.js so staff can see attendance trends and the most popular event locations in interactive charts.
React and TypeScript on the front end, Flask and MySQL on the back end, and Clerk for secure sign-in.

title: Maseria
summary: A mobile and web app that helps small bakeries manage inventory and sales.
details: Bakery staff update stock and record sales from the iOS app, while owners use the web dashboard to see how the business is doing.
Sales tracking and analytics help owners decide what to bake and when.
